primary_review_policy.reason: Known factual contradictions in frozen 7B image judgments. Do not replace pixel-L1 with another unreliable automatic score.
primary_review_policy.label_gate: Every admitted target must be actually viewed by Codex, fully instruction-complete, acceptable in image quality, and tied to exact input/output and contact-sheet hashes. Partial, failed or uncertain direct observations are not admitted.
primary_review_policy.disagreement_policy: Preserve prior 7B disagreement and uncertain observations. Do not claim two-reviewer agreement or human certification. Uncertainty in the designated primary visual review remains excluded.

limits: Controlled-task supervision rather than untouched natural GIER requests.
Codex direct AI visual verification; failed-calibration Qwen screening is advisory only, not a second certification.
Training contains photographs, old scans, illustrations and graphics; this is not a photography-only dataset.
Targets inspected at full-frame preview scale, maximum edge 1024; no fine-detail restoration capability is claimed.
